answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a nectar bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every garden settlement recomputes the yarrow schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
